title: Mock modularity, geometric invariants, and finite pole tomography
exact_target: Explain links between mock modular forms, geometric counting invariants and the OSV framework.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002516 (AIM-PHYSICS-0024). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Gromov-Witten invariants and number theory, source item 5.3.

status_qualification: The source uses Donaldson without specifying the variant; Donaldson, Donaldson–Thomas and Gromov–Witten invariants are not interchangeable. The record remains a broad connection programme and does not assert an unspecified universal equivalence. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
